te: Politico: Slovakia has blocked the extension of anti-Russian sanctions of the EU
de: The Slovak government has opposed the transition to a 12-month extension of individual anti-Russian sanctions of the European Union, which expire on September 15. It's reported by Politico.

de: An unmanned aircraft attacked a fuel depot in the Libyan capital Tripoli. The National Petroleum Corporation (NPC) of the republic reported that the damage was minor.

de: At the Russian Men’s Boxing Championship in Saransk, semifinal fights ended and finalists in 13 weight categories were determined. They also held an official media weigh-in.

de: According to the results of the first six months of 2026, the Social Fund entered into pension accounts of 460 thousand Russians information about the periods of care for people with disabilities and citizens over 80 years old. This is reported on the website of the Fund.

de: On September 2, the Mayakovsky Theatre opened its 104th theater season. At the meeting of the troupe, artistic director Egor Peregudov and director Ekaterina Lapshyna told about the upcoming premieres, tours and other plans of the Theatre.
